metadata.analysis_name: SDH Ranking and Fact-Set Sensitivity Analysis
metadata.hypothesis_statement: Each SDH component contributes measurably and independently to proposition-ranking effectiveness.
metadata.primary_benchmark: Natural Questions MRQA Development Split (N=200, Seed 42)

verified_fields_missing_from_disk_caches: query_similarity_exact_floats (implicit in ChromaDB retrieval; not saved)
exhaustive_candidate_relevance_labels (no graded or unretrieved candidate gold annotations)
data_availability_audit.ranking_and_fact_set_sensitivity_analysi: EXECUTED (Empirically characterizes full-SDH vs pure-similarity traces, fact-set stability, ordering effects, and mathematical properties under fixed weights 0.25)

mathematical_properties_of_components.note: Equal partial derivatives (0.25) reflect equal local coefficient sensitivity under uniform weights, NOT empirical feature importance. Theoretical dynamic ranges describe potential score boundaries, not practical ranking influence.

E.name: Entity Relatedness / Salience
E.qualitative_notes: Measures subject-object embedding cosine similarity with generic pronoun penalty. Factual answers often pair disparate entities with naturally low cosine similarity. Redundant with bi-encoder query-fact embeddings.

I.name: Verb Informativeness
I.formula: Tiered copular penalty (0.20-0.32) + reporting verbs (0.50) + Zipf rank scaling (0.58-0.98)
I.qualitative_notes: Penalizes light/copular verbs and rewards specific lexical head verbs. Qualitatively observed to demote unparsed table headers and copular fragments in edge cases.

U.name: Uniqueness / Novelty
U.qualitative_notes: Sequential and order-dependent within document batch. Cold start is 1.0; candidate facts in single-document benchmarks rarely exceed 0.88 similarity threshold. Largely inactive on single passages.

A.name: Adjunct Density / Context Richness
A.qualitative_notes: Accumulates weighted circumstantial modifiers (cause: 1.2, time: 1.0, loc: 0.9, manner: 0.8). Qualitatively observed to promote rich context in some queries, but inflates complex distractor background facts in others.

full_sdh_vs_pure_similarity_traces.primary_mechanism: Internal proposition ordering within prompt context (affecting LLM position sensitivity), rather than candidate proposition membership.

historical_drop_one_ablation_confound.status: Methodologically Confounded; Retained Only as Methodological Limitation
historical_drop_one_ablation_confound.description: Historical drop-one ablations set one weight to 0.0 and renormalized surviving weights to sum to 1.0, inflating surviving weights from 0.25 to 0.333... (+33.3% relative increase). This violated ceteris paribus and precludes isolating independent component contributions.

q1_component_importance_estimable.question: Does existing evidence permit component-level SDH importance to be estimated?
q1_component_importance_estimable.answer: No. The required per-fact component values (E, I, U, A) and candidate relevance labels are not serialized in existing disk caches.

q2_component_ranking.question: Which SDH component is strongest or weakest?
q2_component_ranking.answer: No component-level ranking can be established from the available data. Theoretical dynamic ranges and equal partial derivatives (0.25) do not constitute empirical importance.

q3_membership_change.question: Does the implemented full SDH pipeline materially change top-K fact membership relative to pure similarity?
q3_membership_change.answer: No. In 94.0% of benchmark queries (188/200), top-K fact membership is identical. Fact membership is altered in only 6.0% of queries (12/200), and 91.7% of those alterations (11/12) are driven by epistemic modality filtering rather than SDH scoring.

q4_selection_vs_ordering.question: Does Full SDH mostly change ordering rather than membership?
q4_selection_vs_ordering.answer: Yes. 79.7% (47/59) of answer-divergent queries pack 100% identical sets of propositions, differing only in internal prompt ordering.

q5_consistency.question: Are ranking effects consistent across questions?
q5_consistency.answer: No. Qualitative inspection shows bidirectional and non-uniform output shifts across different sentence types and syntax structures.

q6_historical_ablation_weakness.question: Does this analysis repair the methodological weakness of the old ablation?
q6_historical_ablation_weakness.answer: Yes. It formally documents that the historical component-drop ablation was confounded by a +33.3% surviving-weight inflation artifact and cannot support claims about independent component utility.

q7_retain_four_terms.question: Does evidence justify retaining the four-term SDH formulation in the paper as a validated objective?
q7_retain_four_terms.answer: No, not as an empirically validated optimization objective. Downstream QA gains over pure similarity are statistically indistinguishable from zero (p >= 0.13). SDH should be presented as an exploratory heuristic filtering prior.

q8_unnecessary_components.question: Does any component appear unnecessary?
q8_unnecessary_components.answer: Component-level necessity cannot be empirically quantified from available data. Structurally, E(s,o) is largely redundant with bi-encoder query-fact embeddings, and U(t,G) is inactive for single-document benchmarks.

q9_future_ablation_justified.question: Is a future clean component ablation justified?
q9_future_ablation_justified.answer: No. Because composite full SDH provides no statistically significant QA benefit over pure similarity, fine-grained component ablation is low-yield.

q10_hybrid_priority.question: Does this change the priority of the hybrid experiment?
q10_hybrid_priority.answer: No. The hybrid diagnostic remains the highest-priority research milestone because SVOA extraction loss (29 pure deficits, 14.5% of the benchmark) is the dominant system bottleneck.

hypothesis_verdict.reason: The required per-component values and relevance labels needed for valid permutation-based importance analysis are absent from existing frozen caches.
hypothesis_verdict.descriptive_statement: Existing benchmark traces show that full SDH can alter proposition ordering, but the relative independent contribution of E, I, U, and A cannot be determined from the serialized evidence.

final_summary.A_analysis_possible: Ranking and fact-set sensitivity analysis comparing full SDH to pure similarity on 200 benchmark questions, fact-set membership stability, prompt order sensitivity, and mathematical property characterization.
final_summary.B_not_identifiable: True component-level permutation importance for E, I, U, and A.
final_summary.C_valid_findings_retained: 141/200 identical answers; 59 differing answers; 47/59 (79.7%) differing answers have identical fact sets (ordering only); 12/59 altered sets (11 modality, 1 SDH budget); 94.0% top-K set retention; zero statistically significant downstream QA gain (p >= 0.13); historical drop-one ablation confounded by +33.3% weight inflation.
